Messages.Author: Timlagor
Messages.Body:
A careful reading of Shilmulo Deception:

Name: Shilmulo Deception [FN:C2]
Cardtype: Reaction
Discipline: Chimerstry
[chi] Only usable when a minion you control successfully blocks (play before
combat). Not usable if the blocking minion played any *reaction cards* that
this vampire could not play. Do not tap the blocking minion; tap this
reacting vampire instead. Now this vampire is the blocking vampire (and
combat begins as normal).
[CHI] As above, and this vampire gets an optional maneuver during the first
round of the resulting combat.

N.B. Reaction CARDS not EFFECTS

seems to indicate that you can play reaction cards at SUPERIOR with one
minion then Shilmmy across to another who could have played them at
INFERIOR. (as well as using ambient intercept on the original one -sport
bike, Winthrop etc).

Is this right?
(I'm sure it will get challenged if I do it so better to check in advance
;-)

--
I always lie.
In the likely event of this not being the case I'm making it up!
Have fun!

This.

> Or no you can't use 'ambient' intercept/effects either?

While technically true, you do get the illusion of getting to use the ambient
effects, since Shilmulo Deception is played after the block succeeds (after
the original blocking minion, using his ambient intercept, succeeded in
blocking the action).

Clearly, ambient intercept effects (Sport Bike, etc.) are not reaction cards
that the deceptor could not play.
